hook: Live Nation cut 16 affirmative defenses to 12 in federal court.

sections.voiceover: Live Nation cut 16 affirmative defenses to 12 in federal court.
b_roll: A formal court document showing defense claims being reduced from 16 to 12.

sections.voiceover: On October 29, the company filed an amended answer in Los Angeles. The Federal Trade Commission sued under the 2016 BOTS Act. Where did the 16 defense claims go?
b_roll: Map highlighting Los Angeles federal court location.
Text graphic displaying BOTS Act 2016 statute title.
Graphic showing 16 defense claims dropping to 12.

sections.voiceover: But Live Nation argued the FTC hasn't enforced this 2016 law against anyone else.
b_roll: Timeline scale highlighting 2016 to present day zero enforcement history.

sections.voiceover: In official filings, Ticketmaster denied profiting from brokers who bypass artist ticket limits. The 33 page answer reduced 16 affirmative defenses to 12 pointed arguments against the FTC.
b_roll: Digital chart outlining artist ticket limit rules vs broker transactions.

sections.voiceover: The State of Tennessee, State of Utah, and Commonwealth of Virginia joined case 8884.
b_roll: Exterior graphic of the Los Angeles federal courthouse.
